meta.name: seo-backlinks
meta.description: Backlink profile analysis: referring domains, anchor text distribution, toxic link detection, competitor gap analysis. Works with free APIs (Moz, Bing Webmaster, Common Crawl) and DataForSEO extension. Use when user says backlinks, link profile, referring domains, anchor text, toxic links, link gap, link building, disavow, or backlink audit.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析网站外链质量与竞争对手差距
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做SEO需要分析外链并发现增长机会
copy.tagline_en: Analyze backlink quality and competitor gaps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do SEO and need to analyze backlinks for growth opportunities

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能分析网站的反向链接，包括来源域名、锚文本分布、有害链接检测和竞争对手差距分析。它会生成一份包含健康评分和修复建议的报告。
howto.when: 当用户提到反向链接、链接概况、来源域名、锚文本、有害链接、链接差距、链接建设、拒绝或反向链接审计等关键词时触发。

say.text: 分析 example.com 的反向链接概况。
say.note: Claude 会生成一份完整的反向链接报告。

say.text: 对比 example.com 和 competitor.com 的链接差距。
say.note: Claude 会找出竞争对手有而你没有的链接机会。

say.text: 检测 example.com 的有害链接。
say.note: Claude 会识别高风险链接并给出拒绝建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze a website's backlink profile, including referring domains, anchor text distribution, toxic link detection, and competitor gap analysis. It generates a report with a health score and recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions backlinks, link profile, referring domains, anchor text, toxic links, link gap, link building, disavow, or backlink audit.

say_en.text: Analyze the backlink profile of example.com.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a full backlink report.

say_en.text: Compare link gaps between example.com and competitor.com.
say_en.note: Claude will find link opportunities the competitor has but you don't.
Claude will identify high-risk links and suggest disavow.
